description: This file defines a class '_PROXY_CacheControlCheck' that acts as a pre-call hook to verify if cache control directives are allowed based on user API key permissions. It integrates with FastAPI to raise HTTP exceptions for unauthorized cache control settings and includes logging and caching dependencies.

classes.name: _PROXY_CacheControlCheck
classes.description: A custom logger class that provides an asynchronous pre-call hook to check if cache control directives are permitted for the user based on their API key permissions.
